newsitem.title: ITALY: Chase raises stake in Italy's Credito Italiano.
newsitem.headline: Chase raises stake in Italy's Credito Italiano.

text.p: U.S. fund Chase Nominees Ltd has become the largest single shareholder in Italian bank Credito Italiano by raising its stake to nearly 3.5 percent from 2.06 percent, it said in a statement on Saturday.
It said the fund had acquired more than 77 million shares for a total stake of 3.483 percent, leapfrogging U.S. fund Fidelity (3.1 percent) as the bank's largest shareholder.

Italian stock market watchdog body Consob said last week that Chase had also raised its stake in Italian investment bank IMI, to 3.06 percent from 2.03 percent, and in publishing group Mondadori, to 3.4 percent from 2.3 percent.
